question: Which of the following Buddhist sites is located in Uttar Pradesh?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sarnath**__.

__
 
• **Sarnath is a Buddhist site located in Uttar Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sarnath** is located near **Varanasi in Uttar Pradesh.**
 
• Sarnath is an important Buddhist site because **Buddha delivered his first sermon **here to his **five disciples**.
 
 
• This is known as ***Dharmachaka Pravartana*** (turning of the wheel of law).
 
 
 
• The **National Emblem of India **is an adaptation of the** Buddhist Lion Capital of Ashoka at Sarnath**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Buddhism and Gautam Buddha**:

 
 
• His real name was **Siddharth**.
 
• At the age of 29, he renounced home, this was his ***Mahabhiniskramana***.
 
• At the age of 35, under a **peepal tree at Uruvella (Bodh Gaya)** on the bank of river **Niranjana**, he attained ***Nirvana ***after 49 days of continuous meditation he got fully enlightened (Buddha or Tathagat).
 
• He delivered his** first sermon at Sarnath **to his five disciples.
 
 
• This is known as*** Dharmachaka Pravartana***
 
 
 
• He died in 483 BC at **Kushinagar**. 
 
 
• This is known as ***Mahaparinirvana***.
